title: Detecting nonzero cohomology of a pseudo-coherent complex by a map to a finitely generated annihilated module
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that a nonzero cohomology group of a pseudo-coherent complex over a Noetherian ring, taken modulo a maximal ideal, can be detected by a map from the complex to a shift of a finite module annihilated by a power of that maximal ideal. The proof begins by choosing the detecting map supplied by the auxiliary statement for pseudo-coherent complexes, then uses Artin-Rees to choose a power of the maximal ideal so that the intersection of the cohomology with that power lies inside the product of the maximal ideal with the cohomology, and takes the quotient by that power as the detecting module.
